text:
alex: Quick design sync — I'm proposing we move the Account <-> Workspace cost toggle out of the kebab dropdown and make it a persistent segmented control at the top of Usage. Hiding it causes a lot of support churn. :thinking:
taylor: strongly +1. I keep getting asked why charts show account totals when the user expects workspace numbers. Toggle needs to be obvious and sticky per user preference. :eyes:
mina: UI detail — when switching scope the chart should animate to new values instead of a full re-render. that helps preserve context for users comparing windows.
frank: Accessibility nit: ensure the segmented control is keyboard operable (tab focus + arrow nav) and exposes aria-pressed or role="tab" semantics. Also contrast between the active and inactive states is borderline.
amanda: Also think about copy: instead of "Account" / "Workspace" maybe "All teams (Account)" / "This workspace" to reduce ambiguity for non-admins. Small microcopy changes reduce support blur.
alex: Agree on copy. Mina — can you mock a tiny microcopy and animation hint?
mina: mock idea: header line: "Viewing costs for: This workspace" followed by the segmented control (default showing scope). Animation: fade + slide on the token bars.
frank: Chart legend proposal: break token usage into three labeled stacks: user, assistant, system. Right now the stacked bars are color-only which is tough for colorblind folks. Add textures or dot patterns in small-screen mode.
amin: (typo) — meant "mina" above.
ux-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: 1) ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text, 3:1 for UI components; 2) keyboard focus order covers toggle, date picker, download; 3) charts have descriptive aria-labels and data-table fallback for screenreaders.
amanda: Invoice placement thought — move "Download invoices" and CSV export near the date-range filter instead of burying under invoices tab. Users often want a CSV for the selected window.
taylor: UX concern: when switching to Account view, show a brief breakdown list of top N workspaces contributing to spend (top 5) so users can jump directly to projects. Could be a small table under the chart.
frank: Performance note for eng — if we keep per-user sticky preference, make sure routing respects cache keys so we don't create a ton of unique aggregated queries. Maybe store preference client-side with a server-side fallback.
alex: Minimal implementation plan: 1) Add segmented control in header + keyboard + aria. 2) Update microcopy to "All teams (Account)" / "This workspace". 3) Chart legend + patterns. 4) Move CSV next to date range. 5) Add top-5 contributors row.
mina: I'll drop two quick mocks in Figma (compact and spacious variants) and add notes for animation and patterns. ETA EOD.
amanda: Can we also tweak invoice page copy: "Invoice total" -> "Invoice total (billed)" to clarify taxes/credits? small but saves tickets.
frank: For QA: please include keyboard-only tests, high-contrast mode check, and chart tooltip focus.
alex: great. if no objections i'll capture this as a small epic and prioritize in next design sprint. tagging @taylor for prioritization and @mina for mocks.
taylor: sounds good. thumbs up from me. :+1:
ux-bot: Deployment note: add a short changelog entry for the new toggle and CSV placement so support can reference it.
mina: mock links: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/usage-billing-toggle (will add frames).
amanda: thanks all — i'll add the microcopy strings to the doc and open a tiny docs PR after the mock lands.
frank: I'll add the accessibility acceptance criteria to the ticket.
alex: closing the thread — will create the epic and link designs. Thanks! :rocket:
